unreachable.proof: All frozen inputs/observed scalars finite; tolerance=0x3aa3d70a >0. Equality gives abs(s-target)=+0 < tolerance, so line1351 breaks before1359. Holds for all finite values, not only sampled inputs.

ShapeDistance distance is zero-initialized early return or nonnegative sqrt of checksum of squares with useRadii=false; finite-domain distance never negative. Both -0 and +0 compare equal. Overlapped equality and false positive side reached.

Unknown is an initialization only. Every terminating break sets state Overlapped2,Hit3,Separated4,Failed1. Other breaks leave inner loops or advance outer iteration. Outer iteration20 forces Failed unless done already set a terminal state. No public finished return with0.
MakeSeparationFunction returns only0,1,2; helper fixture307 checks enum before C. Bad3 produces INPUT_ENUM, never undefined C.
